Base series · B2

Base Set 2

Released February 24, 2000 · 130 cards

Base Set 2 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Base series, released in English on February 24, 2000. It has 130 cards. It includes 100 Pokémon, 23 Trainer and 7 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
